name: WLED
description: WLED LED controllers on the LAN: found by mDNS (_wled._tcp) or added by IP, checked with GET /json/info, streamed with WLED's UDP realtime protocol (DRGB/DNRGB, 2 s timeout so WLED returns to its own effect). Written from WLED's public documentation. Untested: nobody on the project owns a WLED controller. Protocol notes: docs/hardware/wled.md.
